params.linkText: pricing of an upsized secondary public offering

children: of 9.25M shares of its Class A Common Stock by selling stockholder Hagerty Holding (HHC) at a public offering price of $11.95 per share.
HHC has granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 1.39M shares of class A common stock.
Hagerty will not receive any proceeds from the offering, and HHC will bear all associated underwriting discounts and commissions.
HHC intends to use the net proceeds to redeem a corresponding number of its shares for the benefit of the Kim Hagerty Revocable Trust.
The offering is expected to close on or about September 11, 2026.
